subject.title: Reject unsupported diagnostics OTel grpc config

question: Should OpenClaw accept this PR's shipped-config compatibility behavior for legacy `diagnostics.otel.protocol: "grpc"` configs?
rationale: The patch appears correct, but it deliberately narrows a released config enum and chooses a doctor migration that may disable telemetry until the operator selects an OTLP/HTTP collector.

options.title: Accept the narrow contract
options.body: Merge this PR after maintainer sign-off that `grpc` was a shipped no-export foot-gun and that doctor disabling active OTLP-signal configs is the intended upgrade path.

options.title: Require a different migration
options.body: Ask for a revised doctor behavior if maintainers want to preserve more of the existing enabled state or add a different upgrade prompt before merge.

options.title: Choose real gRPC support instead
options.body: Pause or close this PR if the desired product direction is to keep `grpc` in config and implement the actual gRPC exporter path.

recommendation.title: Accept the narrow contract
recommendation.body: Merge this PR after maintainer sign-off that `grpc` was a shipped no-export foot-gun and that doctor disabling active OTLP-signal configs is the intended upgrade path.

likelyOwner.reason: The diagnostics exporter and config surface appear to originate from this history, and the decision is about that product/config boundary rather than a narrow code defect.
